verdict.rationale: Cal.com exposes a full REST API v2 (OAuth/API key auth, bookings, event types, schedules, webhooks) plus a documented CLI recommendation for agents that execute commands, enabling headless/CI automation of scheduling workflows. However, evidence is entirely first-party docs with no independent/hands-on confirmation of running it in CI pipelines, no CI-specific examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), and self-hosting/community reports raise friction concerns (broken docker builds, API not self-hostable) that could affect headless deployment reliability. missing for 10: independent CI/automation case study or hands-on verification, explicit CI pipeline examples, and confirmation that self-hosted headless API deployment works smoothly given community-reported self-hosting friction.
